question: Can you locate any an emergency hospital within 60 kilometers of Taswira, Seattle, WA?
sql: SELECT id, poi_name, wikidata, wikipedia, addr_state, addr_city, amenity, leisure, tourism, cuisine, museum, healthcare, takeaway, drive_through, outdoor_seating, emergency, restaurant FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'hospital' AND emergency = 'yes' AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Taswira%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Seattle%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%WA%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 60000 );
